metadata.title: Curvature quotient flows and Alexandrov--Fenchel inequalities in hyperbolic space
metadata.abstract: We study quermassintegral-preserving curvature flows in $\mathbb H^{n+1}$, $n\geq3$, driven by the curvature quotient $(E_k/E_\ell)^{1/(k-\ell)}$. For $1\leq\ell<k$ with $k+\ell\leq n$, we prove that positive sectional curvature is preserved. Starting from a smooth closed strictly convex hypersurface with positive sectional curvature, the flow exists for all time and converges smoothly and exponentially to a geodesic sphere. As an application, we establish sharp Alexandrov--Fenchel inequalities between $W_k$ and $W_\ell$ for smooth bounded convex domains whose boundaries have nonnegative sectional curvature, whenever $0\leq\ell<k\leq n$ and $k+\ell\leq n$. Equality holds if and only if the domain is a geodesic ball. Together with previously known cases, these inequalities give the full family of Alexandrov--Fenchel inequalities for this class of domains in $\mathbb H^6$. We also construct counterexamples showing that $k+\ell\leq n$ is the optimal range for preservation of positive sectional curvature by these flows.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 双曲曲率流与 Alexandrov–Fenchel 不等式
analysis.workSummary: 在 Hⁿ⁺¹、n≥3 中研究保持 quermassintegral、由 (Eₖ/Eℓ)^(1/(k−ℓ)) 驱动的曲率商流。对 1≤ℓ<k 且 k+ℓ≤n，证明正截面曲率保持；从光滑闭严格凸且截面曲率为正的超曲面出发，流长期存在并光滑指数收敛到测地球。进一步对边界截面曲率非负的光滑有界凸域，在 0≤ℓ<k≤n、k+ℓ≤n 范围建立 Wₖ 与 Wℓ 的尖锐 Alexandrov–Fenchel 不等式，等号仅为测地球。
techniques: 保持 quermassintegral 的曲率商流
沿流单调性及端点推广
analysis.breakthrough: 结合既有情形得到 H⁶ 中该域类的完整 Alexandrov–Fenchel 不等式族，并用反例证明 k+ℓ≤n 对这些流保持正截面曲率而言是最优范围。
analysis.limitations: 流定理的严格凸和正截面曲率条件强于不等式的非负条件；k+ℓ 限制的最优性针对曲率保持，不能据此断言范围外不等式必然失败。Eᵢ、Wᵢ 的归一化须核对正文。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
